questions.q: What is the video about?
o: About expenses in the village and in the city
questions.e: In the video: "Da pričamo o troškovima na selu i u gradu... u stvari, to su finansije" — let's talk about costs in the village and in the city... actually, it's finances.

questions.q: How much did the groceries for lunch cost in the city?
questions.e: In the video: "Uglavnom, ukupno sam sve izračunala: 1070 dinara. Svi sastojci, sve namirnice" — anyway, I calculated it all: 1070 dinars. All the ingredients, all the groceries.

questions.q: How much did a head of cabbage cost in the store?
questions.e: In the video: "A ova jedna glavica je 500 dinara. Opa. I jedna glavica je 500 dinara" — and this one head is 500 dinars. Wow. And one head is 500 dinars.

questions.q: How much does ten eggs cost in the store?
questions.e: In the video: "10 jaja, 220 dinara. Standardno, jaje 22 dinara" — 10 eggs, 220 dinars. Standard, an egg is 22 dinars.

questions.q: How much does parking cost in grandmother's yard?
questions.e: In the video: "Nula dinara parking. Nula, nula. Lična svojina. Može i kombajn, i avion tu može da se spusti." — zero dinars for parking. Zero, zero. Private property. A combine can park there, and a plane can land there.

questions.q: What is done with leftover food in the village?
o: It's given to dogs or pigs
questions.e: In the video: "Svi ostaci uvek idu ili kod kerova ili kod svinja" — all leftovers always go either to the dogs or to the pigs.

questions.q: What work in the village did the author dislike?
o: Throwing in corn and carrying cobs to the cellar
questions.e: In the video: "Ubacivanje kukuruza... Trpanje čutki u podrum i u džakove. Najgore" — throwing in the corn... stuffing the cobs into the cellar and into sacks. The worst.

questions.q: What does grandmother compare keeping track of expenses to?
o: To brushing teeth — it's done automatically every day
questions.e: In the video: "to ti je k'o ono pranje zuba... vodim računa svaki dan" — it's like brushing your teeth... I keep track every day.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: Da pričamo o *troškovima* na selu i u gradu.
questions.e: Trošak — an expense; trošiti — to spend.

questions.q: 64 dinara, još na *popustu*.
questions.e: Popust — a discount.

questions.q: Svi sastojci, sve *namirnice*.
questions.e: Namirnice — foodstuffs.

questions.q: Ostao mi je *višak*.
questions.e: Višak — a surplus, a remainder.

questions.q: Sad smo došli kod babe u *dvorište*.
questions.e: Dvorište — a yard.

questions.q: Tehnički mnogo više *uštediš*.
questions.e: Uštedeti — to save; ušteda — savings.

questions.q: Mi bacamo naše *ostatke*.
questions.e: Ostatak — a remainder, a leftover.

questions.q: Bitno je da znaš koliki su ti *rashodi*.
questions.e: Rashod — an expense, an expenditure.

questions.q: Da pričamo o ___ na selu i u gradu.
questions.e: O in answer to "about what?" requires the locative case: o troškovima.

questions.q: Sad smo došli kod babe u ___.
questions.e: U in answer to "where to?" requires the accusative case; for neuter nouns it coincides with the nominative: dvorište.

questions.q: Kad smo živeli na ___, ništa se nije bacalo.
questions.e: Na in answer to "where?" — locative case: na selu.

questions.q: Svi ostaci idu kod ___ ili kod svinja.
questions.e: Kod ("to, at") requires the genitive case: kod kerova.

questions.q: Brašno 85, to sam koristila u toku ovog jela, ali sam ___ malo.
questions.e: A woman is speaking (sam koristila), so the participle is feminine: koristila.

questions.q: Pa i računaš na neplanirano, pa malo sa strane ___.
questions.e: Setting something aside "for a rainy day" is a one-off with a result: perfective ostaviš. Ostavljaš is imperfective.

questions.q: Ovo uopšte nije scenirano, neću se vratiti ___ kameru.
questions.e: Vratiti se po + accusative means "to go back for something": po kameru.

questions.q: Moram da živim s ___ posle, a ne s babom.
questions.e: S ("with") requires the instrumental case: ti → s tobom.
